| Change how upstreams are generated | `src/cmd/nginx-config-builder/main.go` (buildUpstreamConfig) |

| Change NGINX template output | `templates/*.sigil` |
| Fix release-dir allocation / rollback on `nginx -t` failure | `src/cmd/nginx-config-builder/main.go` (allocateNextReleaseDirectory, handleNginxTestFailure, quarantineFailedRelease) |
| Add a new nginx-custom CLI subcommand (set/get/report) | `commands`, `command-functions`, `subcommands/` |
| Change bash-level nginx build wiring | `functions` (nginx_build_config) |
| Debug cache purging | `src/cmd/cache-purger/main.go`, `functions` (nginx_purge_cache) |
| Change lifecycle hooks (pre-build, post-extract, post-deploy, post-delete) | `pre-build`, `post-extract`, `post-deploy`, `post-delete` |
| Add/change nginx.conf.sigil defaults | `templates/nginx.conf.sigil` |
| Limit req/conn zones | `src/cmd/nginx-config-builder/main.go` (buildLimitReqZoneConfig, buildLimitConnZoneConfig) |
| Run tests | `go test ./src/...`; see `07_TEST_MATRIX.md` |
| Understand release/rollback spec | `docs/spec-auto-rollback.md` |

## Danger Zones

| File/Area | Why It's Fragile |
|-----------|-----------------|
| `src/cmd/nginx-config-builder/main.go` | 1700-line monolith: upstreams, maps, caches, limit zones, release lifecycle all in one `main()`; env-var contract (`mustEnvs`) is strict |
| `conf.d/current` symlink + `release-*` dirs | Release lifecycle is order-dependent; a failed `nginx -t` with auto-rollback changes `current`; shared nginx can break other apps if left pointing at a bad release |
| `functions` / `internal-functions` bash | Heavy dokku trigger usage (`plugn trigger`); `get_container_dns_names` uses `set -x`; `eval` on `nginx-restart-command` |
| `templates/*.sigil` | Template names are computed (`nginxWorkingDirectory`, upstreams); sigil var names must match the Go builder output |
| `post-extract` | Reads config from a container image via `copy_from_image`; fails hard if file missing; deletes sibling `CONFIG.${DOKKU_PID}.*` files |
| `pre-build` | Fails deploy when cache/log root-path properties are unset — global props are required for any deploy |
